name: Hôm Nay Ăn Gì
install:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -d app ] && [ -d /agent/repos/vanphongtuat ]; then cd /agent/repos/vanphongtuat; fi
cd app
npm ci
npm run build
start:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -d app ] && [ -d /agent/repos/vanphongtuat ]; then cd /agent/repos/vanphongtuat; fi
cd app
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8443/; then
  echo "HNG đã chạy ở http://localhost:8443"
  exit 0
fi
export HNG_DEV_HTTP=1
export HNG_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8443
exec npm run dev
